crossRefs.note: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains.” Zebul said…
In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of…
The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

translations.web: He looked up, and said, “I see men; for I see them like trees walking.”
translations.bsb: The man looked up and said, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”
translations.kjv: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
translations.asv: And he looked up, and said, I see men; for I behold them as trees, walking.
